decision_table.name: Determine_NJ_Filing_Requirement
decision_table.description: Determine if corporation must file NJ state corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus.

condition.name: has_physical_presence
condition.comment: Has physical presence in NJ (office, employees, property)

actions.action: // Physical nexus established - filing required // Apportionment will be calculated by tables 7000-7500

rule.policy:
NJ filing required due to physical presence (office, employees, or property in state).
Reference: NJ Rev. Stat. § 54:10A-2 (Imposition of tax) Reference: NJ Division of Taxation Technical Bulletin TB-78 Reference: NJ P.L. 2018, c.48 (Corporation Business Tax Act amendments)

actions.action: // Economic nexus established per Wayfair - filing required // Apportionment will be calculated by tables 7000-7500

rule.policy:
NJ filing required due to economic nexus (post-Wayfair). Threshold: $100,000 in NJ gross receipts OR 200 transactions.
Reference: South Dakota v. Wayfair, Inc., 138 S. Ct. 2080 (2018) Reference: NJ Rev. Stat. § 54:10A-2 Reference: NJ Division of Taxation Economic Nexus Guidance (2018)
No NJ nexus - no filing requirement. Any estimated payments would be refunded.

decision_table.name: Calculate_NJ_Income_Adjustments
decision_table.description: Calculate NJ state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income. Result is NJ "entire net income" (NJ's term for taxable income base).

condition.name: has_nexus
condition.comment: Must have nexus to calculate adjustments

rule.policy:
NJ state-specific income adjustments to federal taxable income. Result is NJ "entire net income" - the base for Corporation Business Tax.
Additions may include: - Interest on U.S. government obligations (NJ Rev. Stat. § 54:10A-4(k)) - IRC Section 199A qualified business income deduction addback - Certain depreciation adjustments
Subtractions may include: - Interest on NJ state and local government bonds - NJ net operating loss deduction (separate from federal NOL)
Reference: NJ Form CBT-100 Instructions (Corporation Business Tax Return) Reference: NJ Rev. Stat. § 54:10A-4 (Entire net income) Reference: NJ Technical Bulletin TB-65 - Federal Tax Law Changes
No nexus - no state adjustments calculated.

decision_table.name: Calculate_NJ_State_Tax
decision_table.description: Calculate NJ state corporate income tax. Applies NJ 9% base tax rate to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

condition.name: has_nexus
condition.comment: Must have nexus to owe tax

rule.policy:
NJ state corporate income tax calculation:
1. Federal taxable income: [Form 1120 line 28] 2. Apportioned to NJ: × [Apportionment %] 3. State additions: + [Additions] 4. State subtractions: - [Subtractions] 5. NJ entire net income: = [Result] 6. NJ base tax rate: × 9% 7. NJ income tax: = [Tax before credits] 8. NJ credits: - [Credits] 9. NJ tax liability (before surtax): = [Tax]
Note: 2.5% surtax calculated separately if entire net income > $1,000,000. Total effective rate for large corporations: 11.5% (9% + 2.5% surtax).
For corporations with allocated net income between $50K-$100K, rates are 6.5% or 7.5%. This implementation uses the standard 9% rate for income > $100K.
Reference: NJ Form CBT-100 Instructions (Corporation Business Tax Return) Reference: NJ Rev. Stat. § 54:10A-5 (Tax rate: 9% base, 2.5% surtax) Reference: NJ Rev. Stat. § 54:10A-5.5 (Surtax for income > $1M)
No NJ nexus - no tax liability. Any estimated payments are refunded.
No NJ taxable income - no tax liability. NJ NOL rules may apply (not implemented).

decision_table.name: Calculate_NJ_Surtax
decision_table.description: Calculate NJ Corporation Business Tax surtax for large corporations. Surtax is 2.5% of entire net income for income > $1M.

condition.name: exceeds_surtax_threshold
condition.comment: Entire net income exceeds $1,000,000 surtax threshold

condition.name: has_positive_tax_base
condition.comment: Has positive tax base for surtax calculation

rule.policy:
NJ Corporation Business Tax surtax applies to large corporations.
Surtax Calculation: - NJ entire net income: [State taxable income] - Surtax threshold: $1,000,000 - Surtax rate: × 2.5% - Surtax amount: = [Surtax] - Total NJ tax: Base tax (9%) + Surtax (2.5%) = 11.5% effective rate
The surtax applies to the ENTIRE net income, not just the amount over $1M.
Example: - Entire net income: $2,000,000 - Base tax (9%): $180,000 - Surtax (2.5%): $50,000 - Total tax: $230,000 (11.5% effective rate)
Reference: NJ Rev. Stat. § 54:10A-5.5 (Surtax for income > $1M) Reference: NJ Form CBT-100 Schedule A (Tax Computation) Reference: NJ P.L. 2018, c.48 (Corporation Business Tax Act amendments)

actions.action: result.nj_surtax = 0.0; // State tax and refund/owed already calculated in table 50480

rule.policy: No NJ surtax - entire net income does not exceed $1,000,000 threshold. Only the 9% base rate applies.
No NJ surtax - no NJ nexus or no taxable income.
No NJ surtax - no positive tax base.
